notes.title: Version 1.3 + 1.4
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Knights, previously I updated the game twice without patch notes, allow me to rectify that and announce some of the changes included in updates V1.3 and V1.4.

Fixes:
-Removed a dialogue Soft-lock with Mirnun (Throne)
-Reduced hitbox size of Halifax's Grapple Attack
-Corrected an oversight with Slipstrike crashing the game upon reloading
-Corrected some questionable punctuation 

Stylistic Changes:[/p][p]-Made shards easier to see on save files
-Adjusted Menu to showcase Difficulty icons and Shards
-Adjusted New Game Plus content to add items sooner
-Adjusted New Game Plus to add Completion data from old saves[/p][p][/p][p]That's all, happy Flinting.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2 and Other Updates
notes.notes:
Firstly, I'd like to highlight a Review done by Marcus Baretta on his channel featuring Flint, thank you for the sustained support and encouragement of us and our game.

[previewyoutube=AvT8WjJfzTU;full][/previewyoutube]

Change Log:

Fixed:
-Overrided a gate protocol in the SlaveMaster final-room that could be closed (reasons undiscovered)
-Main Menu Confirm gates now refocus on saves properly when canceled

Other changes:
-All Triggers have been made more sensitive (from 0.25 to 0.07)
-Collision boxes have been increased from 8px to 16px
-Parry window has been increased from 0.30 to 0.40
-Enemy attack range has been reduced from 1.50 to 1.40

That's all, happy flinting, Knights!

notes.title: Post Launch Update, Flint V1.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Knights.  [/p][p]After looking through the game last night I discovered a list of issues that I've gone ahead and solved, I hope the experience is a little more polished, happy slicin'. [/p][p]-HW [/p][p]Adjusted a spawn point in the Ruins
Conversations now disable AI globally temporarily
Fixed a yield error with Mirnun (Throneroom)
Fixed a error where reverb is only established on grass layers
Controller gylphs have been adjusted on the MenuBar
Nachtkrapp's Attack cycles have been reduced from 3 to 2
Rune Slipstrike damage augment has been reduced from 4.0 to 1.25
Reduced aspects of Upgraded SS_Rune
Jürie damage Has been reduced from 70 to 55
HUD now updates on firing the grenade launcher
DigitalVisor now colours GL Text
Fixed minor typos and grammatical errors and added additional lines
Reduced total armour rating for Battle Breaker Armor from 5.0 to 3.0
Majour & Captain damage rates have been reduced preportionately
Adjusted Geography of Slavemaster F2
Reduced enemy count in Slavemaster F4
Player will now become invincible during last seconds of Slavemaster Bossfight to limit after-defeat deaths
Slavemaster Boss-fight delay time has been increased.
Reduced knockback to entities from explosive attacks.
Fixed an error discovered by a player about crafting menu scrolling
Increased damage of the Mace to outpace the Pickaxe[/p]
